snippet.title: The Sinking City 2 – Game Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order now: https://link.frogwares.com/tsc2  
Coming August 18, 2026 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series.

Surviving Arkham is not an easy task. The city is infested with monsters, dead, and creatures of various kinds and shapes. So you’ll need to plan ahead, gather clues, and retreat when necessary.
